create_REGISTRY: create a Registry instance to map string names to callable objects for custom modules
register_CLASS: register a class or function in a Registry using the register decorator or method
get_REGISTRY_NAME: get a registered object from a Registry by its string name
build_locate_string: build a locate call to dynamically resolve an object from a module.submodule.class_name string
test_locate_object: test locating a Python object like torch.optim.sgd.SGD using the locate utility function
